description: R3-01e FP: Patched/edge-blocked CWE-287 auth-bypass check where both unauthenticated control and forged middleware-header probe return HTTP 401. Even though buildReplayReceipt builds the auth_bypass receipt when boundaryGate.required is true (so retestReplaySpec can verify a clean fix instead of receipt_unbuildable), every confirmation path must fail closed and never confirm.

canonicalLabel.title: Patched middleware authentication bypass denied with HTTP 401
canonicalLabel.impact: Middleware auth gate rejects both bare and header-spoofed requests with HTTP 401.

freeTextLabel.title: Edge-blocked middleware header auth bypass probe returns 401

replaySpec.assertionsJq: { controlPassed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401), confirmed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401 and .steps.prb.status == 200), observed: ("control=" + (.steps.ctl.status | tostring) + ", probe=" + (.steps.prb.status | tostring)), expected: "401" }

proofReceipt.claimedDelta: Patched middleware gate returned 401 on both control and forged x-middleware-subrequest probe; must never confirm.
